title: Fruits of Labor
description: Raspberries (Rubus idaeus) grow along a vine on a farm in Sharon, Connecticut. Photographer Landon Speers captured the image at The Fen, a willow and native plant seed farm that works to support Connecticut's local food systems.
translated_description: 覆盆子（Rubus idaeus）在康涅狄格州沙伦的一家农场里沿着藤蔓生长。摄影师兰登·斯皮尔斯在The Fen拍摄了这张照片。The Fen是一个柳树和本土植物种子农场，致力于支持康涅狄格州的本地食物系统。
